name: Inmate Admissions
description:
This dataset contains individual records of inmate admissions to a correctional facility, with 5,000 sampled rows and seven columns. Each row represents an admission event and includes an inmate identifier, the date and time of admission, the date and time of discharge (missing for about 55% of records, likely indicating inmates still in custody or not yet released), race, gender, an inmate status code, and the top charge associated with the admission. Race is recorded as BLACK (about 56%), UNKNOWN (about 42%), or ASIAN (about 2%). Gender is mostly male (about 92%) with a small share female and a few missing values. Status codes include DE (about 75%), DPV, CS, DEP, and SSR, among others. The top charge field is missing for roughly half the records and otherwise contains codes such as VTL 1192.3 and 120.05.
